subject: Rejuvenating Liver Microcirculation Halves Circulating Alzheimer's Proteins
script: From Agewell Brief: Rejuvenating Liver Microcirculation Halves Circulating Alzheimer's Proteins. By stimulating a crucial nitric oxide pathway, researchers restored aging liver filters and unmasked a cellular signaling cascade that clears neurotoxic waste and LDL. For decades, the search for neurodegenerative disease interventions has focused almost exclusively on the brain. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
